Involvement

Act One

Main article: Steal a Githyanki Egg

If a party member speaks with Varsh Ko'kuu, they can pass a passive  DC 10 Insight Check to deduce that Ko'kuu has been waiting a long time for the last egg in the hatchery to hatch. If they pass the Insight check, they can attempt a  DC 10 Persuasion Check to ask Ko'kuu why he really cares about this egg. If they fail the passive Insight roll, they can still ask Ko'kuu why he cares about one egg via a  DC 14 Persuasion Check.

On success, Ko'kuu reveals that he himself created the hatchery, despite being the last in his clutch to hatch. He believes there could be greatness in the unhatched egg. However, he grows weary and impatient because  Kith'rak Therezzyn might inspect the hatchery soon and command him to destroy the egg. Upon learning this, the interacting party member can attempt to convince Ko'kuu to give them the last egg. Passing one of the following options results in Ko'kuu providing it:

  • [PERSUASION] Why risk its life at all? Give it to me - I'll take care of it. (DC 18)
  • [DECEPTION] You're out of time and clearly stalling - that's why Kith'rak Therezzyn sent me to bring it to her. Hand it over. (DC 10)
  • [INTIMIDATION] You're wasting time. Give it to me now or I'll tell her you're the weakling. (DC 18)

If the interacting party member convinces Ko'kuu to relent the egg through a Persuasion check, he grants them  Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots, which prevents the wearer from taking damage in the hatchery pool.

Companion approval

After convincing Ko'kuu to relent the egg via a  DC 18 Persuasion Check, he asks what the party will do with the egg. The following responses result in companion approval:

  • I'll raise it as if it were my own flesh and blood.
  • I'll find another crèche. One that's more forgiving.
  • [GITHYANKI] I'll see that it becomes the greatest ghaik-slayer you've ever seen.

Any of the above:  -1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

  • I'll make the best omelette you've ever tasted.
  • Depends, how much do you think these things sell for?

Any of the above: +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1 Note that choosing either of the above two dialogue options causes the hatchery to immediately become hostile.
